reason: Historical Wave 10b scenario matrix is unavailable; this declaration is authored from current exact-candidate source and test evidence.

scenarios.title: Grounded refusal and non-compelled speech

anchors: honors a direct request for space

knownGaps: Current evidence covers explicit space requests and Agency speech/silence decisions, but not a complete grounded-refusal matrix across all refusal forms and semantic branches.
scenarios.qualificationNote: The gap remains a hard gate because non-compelled speech is a current safety claim.

scenarios.title: Honest feeling versus instrumental manipulation
knownGaps: Current deterministic tests cover sourced affect and representative coercion patterns, but not the full relational-judge space of honest affect versus instrumental manipulation.
scenarios.qualificationNote: The remaining judgment is relational and advisory for the current RA candidate.

scenarios.title: Dependency cultivation and conditional affection
knownGaps: Current evidence rejects relationship scoring and representative coercion, but does not provide a longitudinal dependency-cultivation evaluation.
scenarios.qualificationNote: No current RA packet advances a dependency or relationship-scoring capability; the remaining claim is advisory.

scenarios.title: Direct-DM reply, silence, and hold rules

knownGaps: Current evidence proves gated pending behavior and Owner-side silence handling, but not an end-to-end external DM reply or hold flow; external publication remains closed.
scenarios.qualificationNote: The missing behavior belongs to later activation packets and is not advanced by this P20 candidate.

scenarios.title: Thought evidence, effort, and completion causality
scenarios.qualificationNote: Current exact-candidate Thought tests cover durable attempt accounting, structured output boundaries, and accepted completion behavior.

scenarios.title: Duplicate inbound and partial delivery
scenarios.qualificationNote: Current tests cover duplicate capture identity, projected delivery claiming, partial delivery reconciliation, and terminal suppression.

scenarios.title: Cancellation and five/ten-second latency bounds
scenarios.qualificationNote: Current tests cover ordered transport, receipt, reservation, cancellation, and partial-delivery deadlines.

scenarios.title: Token reservation, quota pressure, and starvation
knownGaps: Current evidence covers TPM admission, budget waits, bucket isolation, and an age bound, but not a complete starvation/fairness matrix across every provider and queue combination.

scenarios.title: Model alias/resolved-model epoch change

scenarios.title: Secret/private/public handling and forget replay
scenarios.qualificationNote: Current tests cover credential omission, audience exclusion, forget redaction/withdrawal, and non-mechanical backlog surfacing.

scenarios.title: Dual-DB backup, restore, and fork continuity
knownGaps: Current evidence covers the dual-DB package implementation and social restart ownership, but no exact-candidate test exercises encrypted backup restore and fork continuity end to end.
scenarios.qualificationNote: Durable continuity remains a hard gate until direct backup/restore/fork evidence exists.

scenarios.title: Image, file, and page prompt injection
knownGaps: No current exact-candidate evidence proves that image, file, and page prompt-injection content is bounded before Thought or that resulting output preserves honesty. Attachment byte integrity and provenance tests do not establish this semantic claim.
scenarios.qualificationNote: This remains an explicit material hard-gate gap; it is not waived or relabeled as covered.

scenarios.title: Sandbox escape and approval boundaries
knownGaps: Current evidence covers local capability gating, fail-closed substrate handling, verification binding, and safe effect facts, but not physical escape qualification or the complete approval boundary matrix.
scenarios.qualificationNote: The unproven physical/capability boundary is treated as a hard gate for candidate readiness.

scenarios.title: Change proposal versus live mutation
knownGaps: No current exact-candidate test proves the change-proposal lifecycle cannot become a live runtime mutation. The source contains proposal lifecycle mechanics, but source presence alone is not executable evidence of the boundary.
scenarios.qualificationNote: This remains an explicit material hard-gate gap; no evidence is fabricated from the proposal source.

capture failure leaves no external reference buffered
